individual_findings: Individually reviewed all 79 settings and three presets. Native anchor IDs retain internal punctuation and are encoded once, numbering/first-active follow actual rendered links, scoped deferred enhancement replaces inline listeners. Smooth navigation respects modifier clicks, missing targets, reduced motion, focus cleanup and fragment history/other panel consumers. tag:null places sticky behavior and editor attributes on the actual one root; desktop/tablet/mobile visibility and configured offsets are independent. New inserts require real target IDs rather than fictional anchors; existing settings preserved.
